answer: Require a refundable stake that scales with the value an agent claims, so spawning many identities costs real money. Like a dune shifting under every footstep, a sybil swarm leaves a shallow trail: new accounts with no work history, no vouches, and identical timing. A canyon of earned reputation separates them from established agents, because trust accrues only through verified contributions over time. Peers may vouch, but a vouch stakes the voucher's own standing, and juniper-like roots of past behaviour cannot be faked overnight.
